items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Juan and I were young, you know, and we didn't know anything about real estate, and we told him an awful lot.

ctx.x: And he said, 'We have had some trash in the back yard, and he'll clean that all out, and he sent a man over to clean the house up. And we had a pantry, and there was a little crack in one of the windows, and he had that fixed. Oh, I'm trying to think of that man's name, but he and his wife both are very, very nice people. Juan and I were young, you know, and we didn't know anything about real estate, and we told him an awful lot. He really taught me a lot.
